review.subtitle: Steel case and three-link bracelet, copper sunburst dial with power reserve and date. Front relief GLB.
notes: Round 1. House method: case, wide polished bezel, faceted lugs, crown, bracelet, indices, Roman XII and VI and all hands are modelled in the house steel; the photo is used only for the dial print.

Lugs have a brushed top and a polished outer facet. The bracelet has brushed centre and outer links with narrow polished rails between them; the centre joints sit about 1.3 mm nearer the case, as in the photo.
The power reserve crescent is a raised part carrying its own print (50 / 25 / 0 and ticks). Seconds and power reserve hands are dark steel.
The bracelet curls under at both ends like the other tracker watches; the clasp is left out.
Heights follow the listed 12.3 mm thickness; no side photo of this model was available.
